verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents a first-party Exports API. You create an export by type and date range, covering customers, customer screening, screening and monitoring cases, profiles, payment screening cases, transaction monitoring cases and alerts, and transactions, then retrieve it via a short-lived download URL. Transaction data can be exported as CSV, and case audit trails are available via API. However, the file format is documented only for transactions, and nothing shows a complete account-wide export or support for offboarding. Missing for 10: documented open formats for all export types (only transaction CSV is evidenced), a single complete-account export or offboarding/data-return process, and independent or hands-on corroboration that exports are complete.
